content: RSS national publicity in-charge urges vigilance against attempts by anti-national forces to exploit public demonstrations

content: Anantapur district police say around 1,500 police personnel and all polling stations have been integrated into a single digital system to ensure effective police coordination

title: Sugarcane growers intensify agitation across Kittur Karnataka; bandh evokes mixed response; Road blockades disrupt transport in Belagavi, Vijayapura, Bagalkot, Dharwad and Haveri
content: The Karnataka bandh called by sugarcane growers demanding a remunerative price for their produce evoked a mixed response across the Kittur Karnataka region on Saturday, with road blockades disrupting transport and normal life in several parts of Belagavi, Vijayapura, Bagalkot, Dharwad and Haveri districts.

title: Naidu calls for high alert as another cyclone threat looms over Andhra Pradesh

content: Poll body says appeals were filed by State officials under Supreme Court orders, while Opposition parties question who authorised the move and raise concerns over accountability

title: National SARAS Mela to remain open on November 1
content: Even though the meal came to a close on Saturday, organisers have decided to keep it open to the public for one more day; SERP Director (Livelihoods) says mela recorded sales of ₹12.11 crore over the past 19 days

content: Teachers’ and student bodies demand stringent action against the accused; Mahila Commission Chairperson Rayapati Sailaja assures the victim’s family of government support

title: J&K Chief Minister Omar Abdullah marries journalist Nidhi Razdan
content: Posting the wedding pictures on X, Omar Abdullah said, ‘A new journey began yesterday’; Nidhi Razdan also posted pictures with a joyful message, “It’s done bro”

content: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge lists six charges against Gyanesh Kumar, including facilitating vote theft, deleting 13.2 crore voter names and changing Form 6 without parliamentary oversight

title: Former SC development officer in Keralam’s Palakkad gets jail for misappropriation
content: The offence took place during 2002-03, when she was working as the SC development officer in Palakkad block; she reportedly falsified official records, including the cash book and acquittance register, to divert funds amounting to ₹8.96 lakh from three schemes

title: Backed by Naga bodies, Meitei groups hold rally in Imphal for abrogation of SoO truce pact
content: Naga civil bodies held marches in Chandel and Senapati districts, supporting the rally by the COCOMI in Imphal; rallies come days after militants ambushed 14 Meitei men and killed three of them, sparking protests in the State

content: MoU aims to develop EV charging and battery-swapping facilities on Panchayat-owned land, including sites along highways, expanding clean mobility beyond cities and creating a new revenue stream for rural local bodies

title: Jowar prices hit an all-time high in Karnataka amidst drought conditions
content: The price of the Maldandi variety of jowar has increased from ₹5,500 in September to ₹ 8,500 per quintal; Gundu Thene variety is priced at ₹8,200 per quintal, up from ₹5,000

title: Chief Justice of India presents N.R. Madhava Menon award to Attorney General R. Venkataramani
content: The award function was organised jointly by the Bar Council of Kerala and the Bar Council of Kerala Advocates’ Academy for Continuing Legal Education Trust

title: ‘Walk for books’: Hundreds march in Kolkata against attack on bookstalls
content: Citizens, activists, professors, and politicians join the march, which was held without any political banner. It was organised in protest against attacks on bookstalls during Durga Puja, blamed on right-wing groups and the BJP

content: According to the prosecution, a financial dispute over a loan led to the murder; the incident took place on May 24, 2016

content: Inaugurating the seminar, poet Prabha Varma described Namboothiri as a major poet who took the richness of Kerala’s literary tradition to a global audience through modern perspectives

title: Solar power charging taking baby steps in A.P. despite better conditions
content: The State has the perfect sunny conditions to launch solar-powered EV charging stations, but the industry is still in its early stages. It is still facing challenges in the form of high upfront investment and uncertain returns; the State government is aggressively developing EV charging stations, but not the solar-powered ones, says Minister

title: 10th-class girl student attacked with chainsaw in classroom in Anantapur; perpetrator nabbed within hours
content: Victim shifted to Bengaluru for better treatment; perpetrator, a close relative of the victim, was arrested at  Dharmavaram railway station within hours of the incident

content: The inspection follows a recent report submitted by the Forest department to the Revenue department flagging large-scale encroachment on government land

title: Tribal collective seeks wider study into infant deaths in Keralam’s Attappady
content: A delegation of the tribal collective, Thampu, meets Health Minister K. Muraleedharan and calls for a new approach that addresses the social, cultural and economic factors behind the deaths, along with enhanced health-care measures

title: SRFTI students allege continued police presence on campus, raise privacy concerns
content: Addressing a press conference at Kolkata Press Club, the students' union expressed concern over the continued deployment and movement of police personnel on the campus

title: Rural share of Karnataka population to fall to 30% by 2047
content: The rural population is expected to decline from the current 3.6 crore to 2.4 crore by 2047, according to the Karnataka State Regional Urbanisation Plan-2047 report

title: AI must be integrated into thinking and work, says NITK Director
content: Artificial intelligence should be integrated into one’s thinking and working practices, while ethics, compassion and a sense of responsibility towards society must remain central to technological advancement, says B. Ravi, Director of the National Institute of Technology, Surathkal

title: Attappady tribal hospital to get more specialists, newborn care facilities
content: A new block with facilities for newborn care and an emergency operation theatre will be constructed with NABARD assistance, says Health Minister

title: Stage set for polling in 92 urban local bodies in Andhra Pradesh on November 1
content: Polling will be held for 804 corporation wards and 2,382 municipal wards, with 153 mayoral and 367 chairperson candidates in the fray; chairpersons and ward members elected unanimously in eight urban local bodies

title: Row over Puthukkad flyover in Keralam intensifies as NHAI rejects pillar-based design
content: People’s collective challenges NHAI’s stand, warns embankment could worsen flooding, disrupt over 4,000 businesses and isolate public institutions

title: Workshop focusses on family-based rehab of children
content: As many as 7,719 children live in 417 child care institutions (CCIs) functioning across 14 districts in the State.

title: How significant is the TVK-led regime’s move to hold Social Justice Survey? | Explained
content: The feature of an ‘open column’, where respondents can state their caste during the second phase of the Census, to be carried out in most parts of the country during February next year, has forced many parties and other stakeholders to express concerns over the utility of the whole exercise

title: Disruption of convocation at Maharaja’s College: Minister Roji says govt. will not yield to unacceptable protests
content: The Minister says a convocation ceremony carries its own dignity and decorum and that students are assured an opportunity to raise their questions afterwards

title: Godavari region gears up for 14 ULBs amid cyclone recovery
content: After being hit by Cyclone Arnab, Narsapuram and Amalapuram municipalities are going to polls with full preparedness on the ground and restoration of electricity facility without any inadequacy for infrastructure facilities; no election to Kakinada, Rajamahendravaram municipal corporations due to an ongoing legal battle over merger of panchayats

title: 'Secret meets on foreign soil': PM Modi says opposition conspiring to divide nation
content: Accusing opposition of ripping apart the dignity and boundaries of the Constitution, PM Modi said: "Social media is being weaponised to spread rumours and to malign India's image. The citizens of the country must handle this together. We have eliminated Naxalism in far-flung areas, but the threat of 'Dimagi Naxalism' has not yet been averted from the nation."

title: 'Musalmaan hone ki saza': Azam Khan arrested by ED minutes after he gets out of jail
content: Azam Khan was arrested by the Enforcement Directorate just after being released from Rampur jail. He had spent nearly 11 months in custody due to legal issues. His son, Abdullah Azam, was released simultaneously but was not taken into custody. The arrest relates to a 2019 case involving allegations of financial wrongdoing and land-grabbing activities. Khan responded emotionally, asserting that his arrest is due to his identity as a Muslim.

title: Melinda French Gates says her 2-day rule helps employees know they did a good job
content: Melinda French Gates implements a 48-hour feedback rule for employees to manage work conflicts effectively. This approach allows employees to feel secure in their performance evaluations as surprises are avoided. She emphasizes the importance of giving honest feedback with integrity while maintaining respect. Recently, Gates pledged $215 million to improve women's health and called for better accountability in healthcare systems.

title: Georgia developer's 30% profit claim fails as court finds no partnership
content: The business collaboration between Bruce Mortimer and Jeff White culminated in a legal clash centered on a software project. Jeff contended he was promised future profits and operational privileges. However, the Georgia Court of Appeals ruled that an enforceable partnership agreement was lacking due to vague terms. Consequently, White's claims regarding unpaid services and intellectual property were dismissed, highlighting the necessity of explicitly outlining business agreements.

title: Binance replenishes 90% of stolen crypto, says it will absorb financial losses
content: In a commendable move, Binance has restored 90 percent of the cryptocurrency assets lost due to a recent security breach. The exchange has pledged to handle the financial repercussions internally, ensuring customers are unaffected. Withdrawals are set to resume on Sunday, November 1, as Binance reinforces its commitment to transparency regarding its reserves.

title: Ireland's Indian-origin pacer Moondra creates cricket history with 6/26 figures
content: Ireland pacer Jai Moondra made history against Namibia in the fourth ODI, taking six wickets for just 26 runs in 10 overs. His performance set a new record for Ireland’s best bowling figures in international cricket, surpassing Josh Little’s 6/36. Ireland won the match by 130 runs to level the five-match series 2-2, with the decider scheduled for Sunday.

title: Jewish banker's heirs sue Sotheby's over £1.2m 'Nazi-looted' painting
content: A prized artwork by Camille Pissarro is embroiled in a contentious legal battle initiated by the heirs of Salomon Flavian. They assert that the piece was taken by the Nazis during WWII and argue that they were not adequately involved in a prior settlement. Sotheby’s counters, insisting the sale was aboveboard and legally sound. This dispute highlights ongoing hurdles in recovering Holocaust-era property and ensuring rightful family representation.

title: '125 cases a day': Ex-Delhi HC judge reveals what happens inside courts
content: Justice Poonam A Bamba sheds light on the intricate dynamics of the judicial system. She underscores the immense pressure judges face while juggling numerous cases and a mountain of paperwork. Additionally, Bamba acknowledges the vital, yet often overlooked, roles played by court staff, such as stenographers and police officers. The emotional burdens judges bear during trials are also highlighted, reminding citizens to actively seek guidance regarding their legal situations.

title: Island nation’s treaty with Australia raises concerns over loss of cultural heritage
content: Tuvalu's recent treaty with Australia allows its citizens to migrate for work and study opportunities abroad. While migration offers new options, concerns exist regarding the preservation of cultural heritage. Traditional buildings and construction skills might be at risk as populations shift. Researchers are documenting Tuvalu's architectural history through photographs and digital models. Decisions on migration and land use should integrate considerations of cultural heritage and community identity.

title: Hope Diamond was mailed in a plain brown package for just $145 in 1958
content: The Hope Diamond embarked on a remarkable journey in 1958 when it was sent as registered mail to the Smithsonian Institution for safekeeping. This precious gem, with its origins in India, has a captivating royal history. American jeweller Harry Winston generously donated it to the museum after obtaining it from Evalyn Walsh McLean's estate in 1949.

title: 'Keep Rahul mock PM for life': BJP's dig at INDIA bloc's 'public impeachment' of CEC
content: BJP national spokesperson Sambit Patra, who is MP from Puri Lok Sabha constituency, called the "mock parliament" a "drama", and highlighted that the Speical Intensive Revision (SIR) was ongoing and substantiated the claims around the "13 crore delted voters". Earlier, Amit Shah challenged the INDIA bloc to discuss the issue during a special session of Parliament.

title: Patrick Mahomes and wife Brittany bring holiday joy to Kansas City families
content: In December 2023, Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes rallied together for EarlyStart's Clothing Kits for Kids campaign, aimed at aiding Kansas City families with much-needed winter apparel. Their charity, 15 and the Mahomies, generously provided several clothing kits to those in need. A thankful mother applauded the couple's dedication to supporting children and schools throughout the festive season, highlighting the event's role in fostering community solidarity.

title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce donate $1 million to feed 2.4 million New Yorkers
content: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce donated $26 million to charities across the US, supporting food banks, children's hospitals, education and animal welfare. Their $1 million contribution to New York's City Harvest is expected to help provide food to more than 2.4 million residents this summer. Several nonprofit leaders expressed shock and gratitude after learning about the unexpected gifts, which arrived as many communities face growing financial and food insecurity.

title: 13-year-old Goan girl turns backyard moringa into powder business
content: During her summer break, Grace de Souza, a talented teenager from Goa, tapped into her entrepreneurial spirit by producing moringa powder from the leaves of her family's two moringa trees. Her efforts have proven fruitful, with earnings nearing Rs 3,000 from selling 20 packets. Inspired by this success, Grace plans to sustain her small business even when school resumes, embracing the lessons of hard work and responsibility.

title: Man rescued a 2kg bear cub; the 150kg bear still tries to sit on his lap
content: In 2019, electrician Petar Tubic stumbled upon a deserted bear cub named Masa in the woods. Over time, he nurtured Masa, eventually establishing a sanctuary for rescued animals, which now includes an additional bear, Ljubica. However, Tubic is troubled by their strong human bonds, raising concern over the bears' future. The sanctuary has transformed into a community attraction and draws attention to the complexities involved in wildlife rescue.

title: Australia hammered by Harmer in Cape Town as South Africa take series 2-1
content: Chasing a target of 288, Australia were bowled out for 111 in the second session on the final day. The result also took South Africa above Australia to the top of the Test world rankings for the first time since January 2016.

title: Sanjay Gupta's last rites held at Versova crematorium: Celebs arrive to pay last respects
content: The film industry is mourning the sudden loss of filmmaker Sanjay Gupta, who died after suffering a head injury at his residence in Mumbai. Tributes have flooded in from fellow artists and friends, underscoring his significant influence on their careers. At his funeral held at the Versova crematorium, close associates like Sanjay Dutt and Milap Zaveri reflected on Gupta's remarkable contributions, leaving the cinema world facing a profound loss.

title: Kim Jong Un's cyber army: How North Korea's hackers steal billions for regime
content: North Korea has developed a sophisticated cyberwar machine enabling it to target financial institutions worldwide. The country's state-sponsored hackers increasingly rely on social engineering and malware to infiltrate cryptocurrency companies. Cyber operations are essential for generating funds due to international sanctions and economic isolation. Reports suggest that North Korea has stolen billions in cryptocurrency through extensive cybercriminal activity. These actions directly support its military programs and other state priorities.

title: Narang, Usha, Nehwal among 27 names in Draft List for IOA SOM Elections
content: The draft list of nominations has been released for the 2026 IOA Sportspersons of Outstanding Merit (SOM) elections, scheduled for November 9. The list contains 27 candidates—15 men and 12 women—including prominent sporting names such as Gagan Narang, PT Usha, Saina Nehwal, Yogeshwar Dutt and Anju Bobby George.

title: IIT-Bombay suicide case: Sahil’s parents seek CBI probe, CCTV, witness protection
content: Parents of Sahil Wakode, an IIT Bombay student who died by suicide, have petitioned for an independent investigation into his death. They allege that their son faced harassment and caste-based humiliation from a professor. The petition seeks to direct investigations towards actions by those in authority at the institute. They demand preservation of evidence and protection for potential witnesses.

title: INDIA bloc impeachment event: Kharge lists 6 charges against CEC, makes 3 demands
content: Mallikarjun Kharge has initiated a significant public impeachment against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, charging him with vote theft through six detailed allegations, including the controversial deletion of voters and the centralization of electoral authority. The opposition also sought CEC Gyanesh Kumar's removal and an end to the SIR exercise.

title: 'UAE se haare': Ex-cricketer 'fact-checks' Pak PM after 'victory over India' post
content: Pakistan beat India in the Hong Kong Sixes on Friday, a six-a-side tournament in which each team bats for six overs. Following the win, Sharif took to social media to praise the team and congratulate the players.

title: 82% disapprove of Trump. So why are fewer Indian Americans identifying as Democrats?
content: Ahead of the November 3 US midterms, fresh polling shows Indian-Americans strongly favour Democrats on the economy and in congressional races. But a six-year decline in Democratic identification, growing political exhaustion and dissatisfaction with both parties suggest a more complicated relationship with the party.

title: ‘1984 anti-Sikh riots had no justification’: Hardeep Puri ahead of 42nd anniversary
content: Union minister Hardeep Singh Puri spoke out about the lasting impact of the 1984 anti-Sikh riots, firmly stating that no justification exists for the violence inflicted upon the Sikh community. He lamented the tragic toll and enduring pain endured by victims while commending HS Phoolka's tireless efforts for justice. The fight for accountability persists as the search for answers continues decades later.

title: Lebanese couple in tears as buyer vows not to demolish their A$960,000 home
content: In a heartfelt farewell, a Melbourne couple bid adieu to their beloved Maidstone home, a cherished sanctuary for over four decades after immigrating from Lebanon in 1982. Reassured by the buyers' intention to cherish the house rather than demolish it, the couple found solace in their memories. This sale marks a poignant shift as they prepare to embrace a new chapter in Taylors Lakes.

title: Greek shipwreck's 2,000-year-old device was built to predict eclipses
content: In 1900, a remarkable discovery was made when divers stumbled upon the Antikythera Mechanism amidst a shipwreck in the Mediterranean Sea. This ancient artifact showcased astounding knowledge of astronomy and mechanical engineering dating back over 2,000 years. Researchers found it capable of calculating astronomical cycles and predicting eclipses, intertwining science with the cultural tapestry of ancient Greece.

title: 2,000-year-old Roman face cream found with last user's finger marks
content: In a remarkable find in 2003, archaeologists unveiled a cosmetic cream container dating back almost 2,000 years in London. Composed of animal fat, starch, and tin oxide, this ancient formula likely served as a moisturizer. Researchers painstakingly recreated the cream to explore its texture and look on the skin, shedding light on the beauty rituals of the past and our enduring human connection to history.

title: Udupi man dies by suicide at govt hospital after being thrased by girlfriend's kin
content: Pradeep, a 27-year-old man from Nairkodi, was assaulted by the family of his girlfriend after an alleged altercation. The incident occurred on October 27, when several of the girl's brothers attacked him, causing severe injuries. After being hospitalized due to the assault, Pradeep expressed his distress and received threats from the girl's family. On October 30, Pradeep was found to have died by suicide in the hospital's toilet.

title: Tata Sons row: ‘Sebi monitoring all developments,’ says chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey
content: Currently, SEBI is taking charge of governance issues within Tata Sons, the umbrella organization for Tata Group. While Tata Sons is not publicly traded, its subsidiary companies are required to follow SEBI regulations. The regulatory authority has confirmed its vigilant oversight of governance-related events within the group. Additionally, seven listed Tata Group firms have a stake in Tata Sons, and Tata Trusts holds the majority with approximately 66 percent shares.

title: 'Hurt, but still an admirer: Dipke responds to Diljit's Delhi concert remarks
content: Abhijeet Dipke shared his disappointment regarding Diljit Dosanjh's distancing from a student protest. During a concert, Dosanjh defended his choice to remain silent about social issues. Dipke emphasized his long-standing admiration for Dosanjh despite their disagreement on this matter. Meanwhile, Dosanjh reiterated his commitment to love and support for all Punjabis during his performance. The singer addressed criticisms related to his film 'Satluj' and urged unity among the community.

title: How rising rents, living costs are fuelling anger across Europe
content: France is bracing for a wave of protests as widespread outrage over escalating living costs ripples through Europe. Across countries like Greece and Spain, citizens are taking to the streets, raising concerns about housing and wage issues. With minimal income left after covering rent, discontent grows, fueled by stagnating economies and soaring energy prices. Governments find themselves caught between maintaining welfare support and managing financial constraints during these challenging times.

title: Lost job, sold plants from 600 sq ft flat; now has millions in annual sales
content: Brandon Hurst began his journey into plant selling in 2020 as a side project to boost his income. What started as a small venture has blossomed into a thriving family enterprise, with annual sales surpassing 100,000 plants. Leveraging social media, he incorporated livestream auctions that dramatically boosted profits. Now operating from a vast 3,000-square-foot greenhouse in Los Angeles, Hurst aims to expand while ensuring meaningful connections with his customers.

title: Where Allan Donald and Morkel couldn't: Rabada joins Steyn and Pollock in elite list
content: Rabada then dismissed Travis Head with the final ball of the seventh over to reduce Australia to three wickets down.

title: Did comets really start life on Earth? New study challenges long-held theory
content: Researchers from the University of Cambridge conducted computer simulations to examine the role of comets in life's origins. The study found that high-speed impacts likely destroyed important chemicals, such as hydrogen cyanide. Only a small percentage of simulations indicated successful delivery of these compounds by comets. Additionally, most impacts during early Earth history could not deliver intact organic molecules.

title: Blue-green diamond sold for $8.5m in 2014 fetched $17.3m in 2026
content: Ocean Dream, a unique blue-green diamond weighing 5.50 carats, was auctioned at Christie's Geneva for $17.3 million. This diamond, initially sold in 2014 for approximately $8.5 million, experienced a significant increase in value. Its distinct colouring results from natural radiation exposure during its geological formation. Notably, the Ocean Dream was previously showcased at the Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History in 2003.

title: Minecraft creator lists $70m mansion at 2014 price, with $200k candy room
content: Markus Persson, the mastermind behind Minecraft, is putting his lavish Beverly Hills mansion on the market for $70 million. This expansive property boasts eight bedrooms and 15 bathrooms, along with one-of-a-kind features like a candy room and a nightclub. Acquired in December 2014 after selling Mojang to Microsoft, this listing highlights both the opulence of the home and the difficulties of navigating the high-end Los Angeles real estate landscape.

title: Andhra man storms school with chainsaw, attacks Class 10 girl he stalked
content: In Anantapur district, a male assailant attacked a tenth-grade student named Gopika with a saw. This violent incident occurred inside a Zilla Parishad high school, shocking students and staff members alike. Another student, Lakshmi, sustained injuries while trying to intervene and protect her classmate. Local police were promptly notified and initiated a search for the suspect. Authorities are conducting a thorough investigation to apprehend the perpetrator and ensure community safety.

title: Over Rs 1 cr in pocket, yet Pragg calls Clutch Chess campaign 'little disappointing'
content: R Praggnanandhaa finished runner-up at the Clutch Chess: Champions Showdown in Saint Louis, earning USD 109,000 (approximately Rs 1.04 crore). Despite his impressive performance, he admitted disappointment at narrowly missing the title. Uzbekistan's Javokhir Sindarov staged a final-day comeback to win with 20.5 points, finishing 1.5 points ahead of Praggnanandhaa.

title: 'Make Him A Mock PM': BJP's Jibe At Rahul Gandhi Over 'Impeachment' Move
content: The Congress today put into motion what it called a "public impeachment" of the Chief Election Commissioner, Gyanesh Kumar.

title: 'Madam Speaker' At Mock Parliament: Meira Kumar's Polite Sternness Intact
content: Meira Kumar, 81, who was Lok Sabha Speaker between 2009 and 2014, served as the presiding officer at the mock session held by the Congress-led Opposition where Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar was symbolically "impeached".

title: 'Mood Of The People': INDIA Bloc 'Impeaches' Gyanesh Kumar At Mock Parliament, Demands Treason Case
content: The BJP reacted by jabbing Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi, saying he was now "sitting in a Parliament of his own choice, unable to win elections in reality".

content: Nawrocki called urgent talks with political party representatives on Saturday, a day after two senior judges of the Constitutional Tribunal were suspended by a fellow judge.

title: No Number Plate, Black Window: Gurugram Thar Seized Over Multiple Violations
content: The Gurugram Traffic Police said strict action would be taken against vehicles found violating traffic rules and that no leniency would be shown in such cases.

content: A disturbing video showed the eight-year-old boy dragging the kindergartener inside a classroom and banging her head on the desk twice before throwing her on the ground and kicking her.

content: According to police, the abortion was carried out illegally after the family discovered that the fetus was female, amid allegations that the woman's husband and in-laws wanted a son.

content: The latest arrest comes a day after the Mumbai Crime Branch detained the suspect in Sonipat with the assistance of the local police on Thursday.

content: The proposed facility is expected to significantly strengthen Assam's cancer-care infrastructure and provide patients in the Northeast access to advanced treatment facilities without having to travel to other parts of the country.

content: The two victims were from Germany and Slovakia and were staying at the Conrad Hotel, one of the poshest locations in the Karnataka capital.

content: The wedding was preceded by a small family gathering in Srinagar, where close members of the families came together to celebrate the occasion, people familiar with the development said.

content: Powerus began with $5.7 million in assets. Within months, it was a $300 million business, the Journal said. It has won contracts worth millions of dollars in the US and overseas.

title: Tiger Revival In Bengal's Buxa Reserve Hits Snag As Tigress Wanders To Assam
content: For over a decade, the Buxa Tiger Reserve had no tiger population after a decline that began around 2009-2010. Declared a Tiger Reserve in 1983, Buxa forms part of a larger wildlife landscape with connectivity to forests and protected areas of Bhutan and Assam.

title: "Before We Could Figure Out..." Teacher Recounts Andhra Chainsaw Shocker
content: The incident took place around 10:30 am on Saturday at the Zilla Parishad High School in Raptadu village in Anantapur district, while lessons were underway and students were seated inside their classroom.

title: Woman Jumps To Death With 6-Year-Old Son From 18th Floor Of Building In Pune

content: Anticipating protests against Puri's candidature, Bhopal police detained several Congress leaders ahead of the nomination filing.

title: 'It’s done bro': J&K CM Abdullah, Nidhi Razdan share photos of their 'new journey'
content: CM Omar Abdullah and journalist Nidhi Razdan shared photos of their marriage ceremony on social media . sources told news agency that the marriage was solemnised under the Special Marriage Act on Friday . the witnesses included family members from both sides . for 49-year-old, this is her second marriage .

title: Sharmila shifts daughter's wedding venue after brother Jagan's refusal
content: andhra Pradesh congress president YS Sharmila shifted her daughter's wedding to another venue after her brother refused to allow his property to be used for the ceremony . she defended her ownership claim over the property and said it was allotted entirely to her and her children as part of the division of family assets .

title: From asses to masses, Republicans wonder if Trump can still deliver wins
content: president Donald Trump has spent an extraordinary amount of campaign time discussing the physique of other public figures . he is now approaching it with the enthusiasm of a man who has just been informed that his prison sentence has been extended . "my voice is operating at about 49.2%," he grumbles at a rally in Florida on friday .

title: California Halloween store shooting leaves one dead, six injured; suspect on loose
content: one person was killed and six others injured in a shooting at a Spirit Halloween store in Fairfield, California . at least three of the injured were in critical condition . all seven victims suffered gunshot wounds, including the person who died .

title: Buttermilk Falls park set for better access after $1.3m land purchase
content: the open space institute has acquired a four-acre property between the park’s existing entrance and Route 13 in Tompkins County for $1.3 million . the property includes a former bed-and-breakfast and sits at the foot of the gorge that gave the park its name . once transferred, it could support a redesigned park gateway with reconfigured parking, improved traffic circulation, better wayfinding, housing for staff .

title: Haunted, but hardly explored: India's untapped ghost-tourism economy
content: india's ghost villages have a reputation of being haunted in each and every state . there are ghost villages where nobody is quite sure why everyone left . 'dark' tourism and 'spectral' cities are central factions of an ever growing tourist economy .

title: INDIA bloc passes 'resolution' to 'impeach' CEC - top developments
content: the exercise was held amid allegations of irregularities in the special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls under Kumar's watch . the "impeachment" exercise is being held a day ahead of the inDIA bloc's "Delhi Chalo" rally at Ramlila Maidan .

title: 'Won't forgive and forget': Rahul Gandhi at CEC's 'public impeachment' event
content: Rahul Gandhi said that the opposition has enough proof to make sure that Gyanesh Kumar cannot survive as the Chief Election Commissioner . he said that he should not only be impeached but also prosecuted for treason over the alleged irregularities in special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls . the election commission itself is stating that the 2024 Lok Sabha election is an illegal election .

title: Oppn 'impeaches' CEC in 'mock Parliament', but what will it take to remove him for real
content: the opposition unanimously approves a resolution seeking the removal of chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar . he is accused of centralising control over electoral rolls and acting at the behest of prime minister Narendra Modi and union home minister Amit Shah . the opposition is urging the election Commission to function impartially in keeping with the spirit of the Constitution .
